name: Středočeská D3: Praha → Nová Hospoda

A.note: Praha: start of the mapped D3 mainline inside the D0 × D3 interchange, under the road II/101 bridge about 185 m south of the Prague ring (section km 0 lies inside the interchange)

junction.about: The mapped southbound D3 mainline (way 149101901, first node 8227650623) begins 13.7 m north of A, where road II/101 crosses the corridor on an existing bridge (way 171863668, bridge=yes, not in the ground network); the declared ways are that bridge’s two approaches. The D0 carriageways lie about 185 m further north. Section 0301 starts at km 0.000 inside this interchange (ŘSD leaflet).

B.note: Nová Hospoda: the new D3 joins the operating D3 (section 0305/II) where its mapped motorway ends and road I/3 continues north

junction.about: Node 248183130, where the operating D3 (0305/II) mapped as motorway ends and road I/3 continues north: the southbound motorway way 807875702, the northbound link 807875701 into the node, and the I/3 ways 1545424303 and 115670156 that the new D3 takes over. The new D3 continues the operating motorway.
